description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Image_Canvas_GD' which handles image output in GD-compatible formats (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WBMP). It includes methods for drawing shapes, text, images, and managing image properties using PHP's GD extension.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_GD
classes.description: A class for rendering images using PHP's GD extension, supporting various shapes, text, images, and fill styles with options for antialiasing and clipping.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_GD
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GD canvas, optionally from an existing GD resource or image file, and sets antialiasing options.

methods.name: _getGD
methods.description: Private method to load an image file into a GD resource based on its format (PNG, JPEG, GIF).

methods.name: _color
methods.description: Private method to get the GD color index for a given RGB color or transparency.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Private method to determine the GD line style resource based on current style settings.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Private method to determine the fill style, including solid color, tiled, or gradient fills.

methods.name: setFillImage
methods.description: Sets an image file to be used for filling shapes.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets font options for text rendering, including TTF font, size, and angle.

methods.name: _linePixels
methods.description: Calculates pixel points along a line for antialiasing.

methods.name: _antialiasedLine
methods.description: Draws an antialiased line between two points.

methods.name: _antialiasedPixel
methods.description: Draws an antialiased pixel with weighted color blending.

methods.name: drawEnd
methods.description: Draws various end shapes (circle, diamond, line, box, arrow) at a specified point.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points, with optional antialiasing.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon with options for fill, stroke, and antialiasing.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with optional fill and border.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse with optional fill and border.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice shape with optional fill and border.

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a given text string.

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of a given text string.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Draws text on the image with alignment and font options.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image file onto the canvas with optional resizing and alignment.

methods.name: setClipping
methods.description: Sets or resets a clipping region on the canvas.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML tag for the current canvas, saving the image to a file.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets drawing styles and polygon data.

methods.name: _version
methods.description: Detects the GD library version installed (1.x or 2.x).
